payload.text: At the 0.1.6 cut, check ISSUE:0004's end-to-end run: hv pushes the tap's 1e74059 first; bin/devbin release 0.1.6 leaves CI's draft holding four archives and SHA256SUMS.ci; bin/devbin macos finalize v0.1.6 publishes, and a second run verifies the public release and changes nothing; bin/devbin formula publish puts in the tap exactly the sha256 values in the release's SHA256SUMS.
